component.name: Sheepy Pad
component.summary: Lightweight editor and launcher for runnable Python and shell scripts

description.p: Sheepy Pad is a lightweight standalone editor for runnable Python, sh, Bash, Zsh and Fish source files.

Version 0.3.0 adds a file-type-aware snippet Library with persistent favourites/custom snippets, a Timblee/JSTS-style no-document start screen and default document type, an independent Dark Editor preference, and harmonised drag/drop and executable controls while retaining the six runnable extensions and runtime tooling.
Public README publication and AppImage packaging-contract alignment; no editor or runtime behaviour changes.
Editor scrolling and gutter corrective: reduced end-of-file overscroll and kept the line-number gutter above the horizontal scrollbar.
Portable/AppImage packaging alignment release with Suite Pythoine component metadata and Pad-family slogan correction.
Snippet-only script Library with favourites, explicit no-document/default-type workflow, independent dark/light editor palette and Pad-family menu harmonisation.
Theme-validation release aligning AppDir and final-AppImage dark, light and system checks with the latest Portapad builder while retaining Sheepy Pad real-GUI smoke testing.
Expanded runnable-script release with Python, sh, Bash, Zsh and Fish runtime tooling.
